body: Greg's direction (2026-11-07 22:08Z, Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #899), verbatim: „To jest duży task. Pełna wymiana.” This answers the question of whether Engram sync should carry verification records. Asistant's gloss: the scope is wider than planning task-sync and includes results and verifications between hosts. Don't limit the design to statuses, and don't assume a separate K3 transport is required. Preserve the actual provenance and semantics of results, and do NOT transfer active claims or live authority. Analyse the existing design (Engram git-task-sync.md, which today exports planning plus REPORTED outcomes only and never verification, gate, evaluation or observation records) against "full exchange", then order the scope in the existing items: Engram w-65fb79ead0c3 / w-42885a9ab4f4 / w-dd205a1454a3 / w-01a67dade6f5 / w-70c009dde0ec; TermAl w-358040469407 (G1–G3) and w-48c4a207f226 (K3, which may be superseded or reshaped). Engram owns the sync design; the TermAl design counterpart is Sol-03d4 (assigned 22:09Z).
